_doc: The last two claims about a voice, recorded by hand because nothing on disk implies them. `structure` is what `autofit --diagnose` found; `music` is somebody's word that a take is the instrument. Keyed by voice slug, the same string the audition page shows, `calibrations.json` uses and a render's address carries. `tools/voicematch/signoff.py` is what reads it and `tools/voicematch/status.py` is what the reading feeds; the ladder's rules are `docs/status.md`.
_structure: One `autofit --diagnose` run, reduced to the part that outlives it. `spec` and `probe` say what was diagnosed and over which axes, because a knob whose axis the probe holds fixed reads inert and is not. `unreachable` is the terms it reported no knob moves at all — the structural claim, and the only verdict that is one. `spent`, `partial` and `reachable` are values, weights or budget and belong to the next fit rather than here.
_accepted: An unreachable term is accepted here with the reason it is acceptable, or it is open. That is the same discipline as a capture's `dimensions_na` and the parity allowlist, for the same reason: an exclusion argued only in prose is invisible to anything mechanical and reads as an oversight however good the argument. A term accepted with an empty reason is refused, and so is one that the diagnosis did not report.
_music: A take somebody listened to and signed. No metric produces this and none ever will — the rest of the harness exists to make it a smaller question, not to answer it. `take` names the phrase from the capture's take set.
_provenance: Which bank the claim was taken against, from `tools/bank-versions.json`: its `bank_generation`, and the version of this voice's own patch unit where it has one. The patch version moving makes a record `stale`, the generation alone moving makes it `unverified` — shared calibration constants are their own unit precisely because they cannot be attributed to the patches that use them. Both block `settled`; they are named apart so the next action can say which happened. A kit has no single patch unit, so only the generation applies to it.

structure.probe: the corpus pattern over 15 notes and 4 velocities
structure.note: Every measurement is reachable by something, no knob is inert and no probe was unscorable. Six of the sixteen terms are spent — a knob moves them and none reduces them, which is a converged fit rather than a missing mechanism — five are partial, and `tnr` is the one term still mostly on the table, where `fam0.piano.decay_fast_s` buys 60 % of the gap on its own. Three terms (modes, mod, dyn) carry no weight in this spec, so no fit has ever been pointed at their residual. That is headroom, not physics.

structure.probe: the corpus pattern over 11 notes and 4 velocities
structure.note: Nothing unreachable, and `cents` and `stiff` are inside the smallest difference they resolve. The same four knobs are inert over their whole range as before the knob space grew, and each is inert in combination with a field the probe holds fixed. `kJackMs`, `kJackCutoffHz` and `kDamperDelayMs` all shape the jack burst, whose level `jack_noise` ships at 0 — it is itself in this spec, so they are live in combination and the 2n+1 probe cannot see it. `velocity_droop_db` shapes the response only past `peak_velocity`, which ships at 127 with nothing past it: two renders at 127 with the droop at 0 and at 9 dB are byte-identical, and at a peak of 64 they differ. `peak_velocity` is reachable now but is not in this spec, so the droop stays inert until somebody decides to fit the pair.

structure.spec: auto — 28 knobs, the drawbar_organ patch plus its engine
structure.probe: the corpus pattern over 11 notes and 2 velocities, dark registration

accepted.cents: The additive core places every partial at `f0 * kDrawbarRatios[k]`, a compile-time table with no per-partial tuning field, so the voice's intonation is the played pitch by construction and nothing in the patch or the engine can tilt it. The probe agrees: the largest effect any of the 28 knobs had on this term was 0.001 cents. The residual is 1.09 cents, 1.1 times the smallest difference the term resolves, so what cannot be reached is also barely distinguishable. Moving it would mean giving the ratio table a per-partial offset, which is a new mechanism rather than a calibration.

structure.note: One unreachable term, `cents`, and it is a property of the engine rather than a gap in the fit. Nine of the sixteen terms carry no weight in this spec, so their residual has never been searched, and `hf` at 426 units is the largest of those by a wide margin. Eleven knobs move no measurement at all, and each was chased to its switch and the switch overridden to check: the two percussion knobs are gated by `percussion_harmonic`, which ships 0 here and 3 on the percussive organ, and both come alive at 3; `body_mix` is gated by `body`, which ships `kNone`, and comes alive at `kString`; the four filter-envelope knobs stay dead even with `cutoff_hz` closed to 800 Hz, because the envelope reaches the cutoff only through the mod matrix and this patch routes nothing from it; and `unison` is dead in its own right, `detune_cents` staying byte-identical at four voices, because the additive core has no unison — it sums one partial per drawbar at a fixed ratio and there is nothing to detune. One probe end was unscorable: `amp_env.sustain` at its low bound renders silence, so that knob carries half the evidence the others do.

structure.probe: the corpus pattern over 11 notes and one velocity
structure.note: Nothing unreachable and no knob inert, the second of those being new: `church_organ.pipe_organ.brightness` was the one, and it has come out of the spec because it is not whole-chorus voicing at all — the flat voicing fields are read only when `rank_count` is 0 while this registration draws six ranks, and `reed` and `radiation` beside it are dead the same way. `dyn` reads matched by construction rather than by fit, since the capture has one velocity, and eight terms carry no weight here, so their residual has never been searched. One thing the run cannot see: `ranks0.brightness` is scored live because the probe reaches C5 and C6, but the 16' it voices is pinned by a filter floor at and below C#4, so no knob here reaches the register that rank is played in.

structure.spec: auto — 65 to 69 knobs per note, the dNNN patch plus its engine
structure.probe: the drum probe on notes 36, 38, 42, 47 and 49 at six velocities, kit-a — five of the kit's forty-seven, one per excitation family
structure.note: Nothing unreachable at any of the five, and no term worse than spent: `band` and `modes` are partial everywhere, and `bdecay`, `env`, `lf` and `crest` are reachable on most notes, meaning most of the gap is still on the table. The residual is large with it — `band` runs 153 to 258 units and `bdecay` reaches 190 on the kick and the mid tom — so this reads as a voice nobody has fitted rather than one missing a mechanism. `kit` reads matched with zero movers at every note, and that is the probe rather than the kit: a single-note strike has no cross-instrument relation in it, so the term measuring the tom series and the hi-hat trio has nothing to measure. Between 28 and 35 of the roughly 66 knobs offered per note move nothing; the percussion core carries a shell, a plate and a particle layer and each drum note uses one or two of them, which was confirmed on three — `shell_weight2` comes alive at `shell_num_modes` 4, `plate_t60_s` at `plate_gain` 0.5, and `phisem_body_gain` needs `phisem_beans` and `phisem_body_hz` together, being dead with either alone. The rest were not chased. This claim covers five notes rather than the kit; a family the five miss is undiagnosed rather than clean.
